notes.title: Pharaoh Rebirth+ Update : Vsync & Black bar option, analog stick adjustment
notes.content:
[h1]Update Detail[/h1]

[list][*] "Vsync" option added to startup dialog
[*] "Full screen keep ratio" option added to startup dialog to prevent stretching when playing on widescreen
[*] Adjustment to the sensitivity of the analog stick
[*] Fix for a bug that could cause massive slowdowns
[/list]
